# Shift-left code review report

For spec-driven work, use this report for one adversarial review round at the end of implementation, after all slices and final verification. Use a strong model if available; otherwise the engineer may run the review skill manually. Targeted checks after resolving findings are verification, not another adversarial review round.

> Change/PR: <link or identifier> · Reviewer: <person/agent> · Date: <date>

- Spec / acceptance criteria:
- Diff/commit reviewed:
- Agreements and relevant standards:
- Checks actually run:

## Findings

For each finding, include severity, file/line, concrete scenario, impact, evidence, and a recommended correction. Do not report style preferences without an applicable project rule.

| ID | Severity | Source (tool/reviewer) | Rule / tool | File:line | Scenario and impact | Evidence | Status |
